jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Art direction for a warm painted-diorama 3D exploration game. Mid-poly readable geometry, selected soft bevels, large matte color planes, restrained hand-painted detail, clustered asymmetrical tree crowns, warm gray faceted rocks, olive/sage foliage, terracotta roofs, cream plaster, warm timber. Soft clear illumination, opaque ivory background, no dark background, no glossy clay, no photographic microtexture, no brands, no watermarks. Show original assets inspired by a coherent modular village-and-forest world. Make a wide landscape model reference setup sheet of exactly 7 nature masters, each on its own labeled region: OAK large tree with branching trunk and grouped irregular leaf masses, PINE layered lobed conifer, BOULDER broad warm-gray bevelled stone, SLAB tall chipped stone, GRASS five broad curved blades in a tuft, SHRUB dense asymmetrical leaf-mass bush, CLIFF modular 4m-wide stratified rock ledge with flat top. Each region shows one large three-quarter view and a smaller front silhouette. Tree foliage is geometric volume, not a cloud of individual leaves; rock plants separate. Clear empty gaps, complete silhouettes visible, include a tiny neutral 1.8m human ruler by large items. Trees ~8-10m tall, slab 3m, boulder 1.5m, shrub 1m. Designed for procedural rebuilding in Blender. Layout professional, shapes specific and attractive.

All modules isolated, no assembled buildings or foliage. Clearly show join edges and slab thickness. Opaque warm-white backdrop.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game material texture master, single square image. Generate quiet meadow grass surface, tiny broad painted grass strokes woven into subdued organic turf patches, no individual grass objects or flowers. Full image is a flat orthographic material scan, edge-to-edge, no perspective. Warm painted diorama art style but completely neutral grayscale RGB to multiply by a game color palette. Values mostly light gray to off-white (roughly 75 to 95 percent brightness); gentle low contrast; darker joints no lower than medium gray. Uniform flat ambient illumination, no directional highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette, no object silhouettes or frame. Perfect seamless repeat across opposite left/right and top/bottom edges; pattern continues across boundaries. No letters, labels, watermark, contact sheet borders, measurement marks, grid gutters, or color swatches. This is a usable texture candidate, not a rendered sphere or material preview. Square at high resolution.
